products.name: AutoBuild
products.description: Linux-verified release for trusted Python and Node projects: copy, detect, optionally install dependencies, run checks/builds, report results and generate a launcher when possible.
features: Scans and understands existing project folders
Builds and tests supported websites, apps, and software

products.name: SCIOS Project Auditor
products.description: Local project verifier that checks common manifests and structure, scans for likely exposed secrets, runs supported test/build commands, and reports READY, NEEDS_WORK, or BROKEN from observed evidence.
features: Detects Python, Node.js, Rust, Go, Flutter, Gradle, Maven, and common web projects
Produces text or JSON evidence reports
